mainEntity.name: What is the best Web3 marketing agency in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most founders at seed to Series A, the best fit is a fractional senior operator rather than a traditional agency. The person running your media, KOL and narrative strategy is the person you hired, not an account team rotating between twenty clients. Shilika Jain runs Web3 PR and marketing directly for $5K–$12K/month and has placed 50+ founders across Forbes, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block and Blockworks.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Web3 marketing agency cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-service Web3 agencies typically charge $15K–$45K per month, which covers a multi-person account team, reporting overhead and agency margin. A fractional senior operator delivers the same senior scope for $5K–$12K per month. A focused launch sprint, covering positioning, press and KOL activation, runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. KOL placements layer on top: nano-tier $200–$1.5K per post, micro $500–$5K, mid-tier $10K–$30K, macro $25K–$100K and above.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and deliverables do you actually produce?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto editorial: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream business press where the angle justifies it: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP and CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Alongside press, the standard retainer includes founder positioning, op-ed ghostwriting, KOL brief and outreach, and AI-search citation structuring. Coverage is earned on a real news hook.

mainEntity.name: What does the process and timeline look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Week one is an audit of your existing press footprint, competitive narrative and the story worth telling. Week two produces the positioning brief and the journalist and KOL map. Weeks three and four are outreach, embargo management and KOL activation. Ongoing retainer work follows a monthly cadence of announcements, op-eds and sentiment tracking. A launch sprint from brief to first coverage typically runs four to six weeks.

mainEntity.name: How do I start working with you?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your press footprint and where the best story is. Alternatively, book a 30-minute call and we will map it out live. No deck required and no intro call with an account team before you speak to the person doing the work.
